handoff: Review #2: review #1's blockers are fixed. Unit 1090 pass, typecheck green, docs:emit clean, rule fold faithful. Blocking: (F1) Reference config table types come from defaults (runner/base_branch show 'null'; per-agent and options keys missing, B9); (F2) HC11 still says the README documents the herdr plugin install; (F3) the rule-id lint misses duplicated or unpinned ids, though AGENTS claims it catches them. Minor: marker-drift comment, command-lint gaps, flags with no description, limitations wording, §13.1 heading.

findings.title: Config key types come from the default value, not the schema
findings.detail:
docs/reference.md:483 and :490 list `runner` and `base_branch` with type `null`. The schema has RunnerConfig|null and NonEmpty|null. `agents.claude` shows as an opaque `map`, and the per-agent keys (command, args, model, env, capabilities), runner.options and the notifier options are not listed. B9: 'names each key of the repo config with its type and default, matching the config schema'. typeOf derives the type from the built-in default.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Take the types (and nested keys such as agents.<name>.*, runner.*) from the ConfigLayer schema, or at least render nullable defaults as '<type> or null' and list the per-agent keys. Then regenerate.

findings.title: HC11 points at the README for the Herdr plugin install
findings.detail:
HC11 says 'the README documents `herdr plugin install …`'. After the rewrite the root README no longer does; the install is in plugins/herdr/README.md. The fold left a pointer at text this story moved.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Make HC11 name plugins/herdr/README.md.

findings.title: Rule-id lint misses a duplicated or unpinned id
findings.detail:
The lint counts only the pinned ids. A new id defined twice passes, and so does an id that is not in the pinned list. AGENTS.md (Commands) says the docs lint 'fails on a rule id defined twice'. D8 says new ids come only through a later story.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Assert that every id defined in RULES.md is unique, in addition to the pinned-ids-exactly-once check. Optionally assert that the defined set equals the pinned list.

findings.title: The marker comment claims a drift test that does not exist
findings.detail:
The comment says 'the table test below fails if they drift', but GEN_START/GEN_END are only used by codeOf. If the markers drift, the command lint silently scans the generated block.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Assert that Reference contains each marker exactly once, or fix the comment.

findings.title: Command lint gaps
findings.detail:
(a) The greedy argument group swallows a second `norn` on the same span or line, so `norn status then norn tick` checks only the first. (b) `norn --flag` with no command is skipped. (c) commandTable never resets `current` at a ###/#### heading, so a flag bullet after the last command heading would attach to that command. None of these hit the current docs.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Split on each `norn` occurrence and reset current at headings.

findings.title: Some flags have no description
findings.detail:
`norn status --segment` and `--ttl` (and `help --all`) are listed bare, because their option help line is empty.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Acceptable since the text comes from the CLI, but consider a fallback, or a follow-up issue to add the help strings.

findings.title: Limitations wording
findings.detail:
'The inbox now says…' is since-fixed phrasing. Item 8 groups 'No backfill' under 'Attended steps'. The extra sections 'Proven envelope' and 'Not built yet' go beyond the three B16 names, which is acceptable.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Drop 'now' and move the backfill bullet to its own item.

findings.title: §13.1's heading misdescribes part of its contents, and T rules restate R rules
findings.detail:
§13.1 'Claim loss and recovery' also holds R4 (nudges), R6 (prompts), R8 (shim) and R9 (launch prompt). T5, T6a, T7 and T7a–c restate R2, R3, R7 and R10 almost word for word (inherited from the PRD). This is the accepted deviation from D2.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optional: rename the heading, or move R4/R6/R8/R9 next to §9.

findings.title: Duplicated fence-toggling loop and marker constants; the test imports a script module
findings.detail:
The fence toggle is repeated in anchors, the link sweep and codeOf. The start/end indexOf pair is repeated in reference.ts:83/91. reference.test.ts imports freshReference/ROOT from scripts/docs-emit.ts. The version regex misses two-part 'as of 0.17'. reference.test's flag check matches `--base` inside `--base-ref`. The 'spec ids stripped' test can pass vacuously.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Extract helpers. Move freshReference into src/.
